questions.question_text: Defining the Purpose of Your EventWhat is the primary reason for defining the purpose of an event?

options.text: To decide on the event’s decorations and theme
To guide every decision and keep the planning focused on a specific goal
To choose the best location for the event
To determine how much money to spend on food

correct_answer.text: To guide every decision and keep the planning focused on a specific goal

questions.question_text: Identifying Your Target AudienceWhy is it important to understand your target audience when planning an event?

options.text: It helps you set a budget for the event
It ensures the event’s timing, activities, and promotion match the needs and interests of the attendees
It determines how many team members you need to plan the event
It decides the type of food you should serve

correct_answer.text: It ensures the event’s timing, activities, and promotion match the needs and interests of the attendees

questions.question_text: Creating a Vision BoardWhat is the main purpose of creating a vision board for an event?

options.text: To create a detailed budget plan for the event
To visually capture the theme, vibe, and goals of the event to inspire and guide the planning team
To list all the tasks needed to complete before the event
To convince the school principal to approve the event

correct_answer.text: To visually capture the theme, vibe, and goals of the event to inspire and guide the planning team

questions.question_text: SMART Goals for EventsWhich of the following is an example of a SMART goal for a school fundraiser?

correct_answer.text: “Raise $200 for the drama club by selling 100 cookies at $2 each by next Friday, promoting during lunch periods, to support our upcoming play.”
